newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Italy discount rate unaffected by ERM rate - Fazio.
newsitem.headline: Italy discount rate unaffected by ERM rate - Fazio.

text.p: Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said on Sunday that the lira's entry level into Europe's monetary grid at 990 lire to the mark will not influence the bank's policy on the discount rate.
He told reporters that the agreed rate was sustainable and gave the lira room to appreciate.
Treasury Minister Carlo Ciampi, also present, said the agreed rate was satisfactory and was not far from Italy's earlier target of 1,000 lire per mark.
"The parity will have no influence on the prospects for the discount rate (cuts)," Fazio said, adding that the inflation rate would be the chief factor.
Asked if the parity rate was sustainable he said: "Yes. The current parity is close to equilibrium."
"The parity incorporates the idea that the rate can still strengthen," he added.
Ciampi said that he was satisfied with the result of two days of hard bargaining.
"I am satisfied with the parity, I believe that having obtaining the general consensus of the partners on the 990 rate is a rather positive result," he said. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
